text:
sara-ml: heads up — after q6b-int4 bring-up we saw a surprising rerank regression on the golden set vs baseline q8b. perf numbers look fine, but quality delta shows ~5% drop on rerank metric.

ben-eng: can you paste a failing example? is this across classes or concentrated?

sara-ml: one quick example (shortened):
```
input: 'Summarize the policy changes in plain english.'
baseline(q8b): 'The policy reduces X, expands Y, …'
q6b-int4: 'This policy might do something about X but unclear on Y.'
```
seems like q6b is truncating or mis-scoring relevant spans.

eva-quant: interesting — early suspicion: tokenizer/byte-pair merges changed between the model artifacts we onboarded and the eval harness tokenizer. small token shift -> different attention alignment -> rerank score swings. i saw similar for long prompts.

andre-qa: i ran a diff on token ids for 50 failing cases — ~30% have mismatch near punctuation/quotes. when token ids differ the reranker logits drift a lot.

mina-ops: deployment note: we briefly routed canary traffic to q6b-int4 for 2 hours then stopped once we saw alert. no wide exposure.

ben-eng: ok action items: 1) confirm tokenizer versions used during model export vs eval; 2) run a tokenization parity pass across the golden set; 3) triage whether dedupe/labeling errors are inflating the delta.

sara-ml: i'm on (1) now — model artifact metadata shows tokenizer_version: v2b and our eval harness used v2a. that explains a lot.

labelops-bot: I queued a tokenizer-parity rerun for golden subset (n=1200). est ETA: 6h. priority: high.

labelops-bot: Note: dedupe bucket X has 240 near-duplicates flagged; relabeling those could change metrics.

andre-qa: quick manual spotcheck of 20 mismatches: 12 are purely tokenization noise, 6 are real output differences, 2 are labeling inconsistencies in the golden.

eva-quant: for quant experiments we should isolate quantization-induced behavior from tokenizer effects. propose: rebuild eval traces with correct tokenizer, then produce two runs: q6b-int4 (current) and q6b-int4-quant-repro (re-export with a fixed tokenizer shim).

ben-eng: agreed. also propose we run a small canary with tokenizer pinned to model artifact during retrain — we can use the pinned tokenizer container image: registry.redwood.internal/qtoken:v2b.

mina-ops: can do. i'll spin up a 10-node canary pool with pinned tokenizer image and route 5% test traffic. want me to include cold-start metrics?

sara-ml: yes include latency, rerank delta, and tokenization parity report. i'll collate.

labelops-bot: relabeling queue capacity check: estimated human hours for dedupe-relabelling: ~18h (2 labelers full day). we can fast-track 2 labelers tomorrow.

andre-qa: suggestion: before relabeling whole bucket, run a micro-golden (n=150) chosen by highest metric influence (per Shapley-ish scoring). if metric flips there, escalate to full relabel. saves labelops cycles.

eva-quant: +1. i'll compute item influence scores and output top150.json to 
https://internal.redwood/sprints/q6b-token-parity/top150.json

ben-eng: timeline: tokenizer parity run ~6h, micro-golden selection + QA ~3h after that, canary with pinned tokenizer by EOD tomorrow. if micro-golden shows noise -> relabel full flagged bucket.

mina-ops: starting canary infra now (no traffic until we have pinned image).

sara-ml: thanks all. small note: keep a watch on long-context examples. previous quant drops were concentrated at >1024 tokens.

labelops-bot: acknowledged. queueing micro-golden samples and notifying labelers @labeler-team.

andre-qa: will document a quick reproducibility checklist once we confirm tokenizer parity so onboarding stays smoother next time.

ben-eng: assign owners: tokenizer parity & parity run - sara-ml; micro-golden selection & influence calc - eva-quant; infra/canary - mina-ops; relabel ops - labelops-bot / labeler-team. update in thread when parity run finishes. :thumbsup:
